records.decision: Included both existing Practice scripts, with their standard and low-capacity routes, instead of a single one-world extract.
records.reason: Every canonical SS01, SS02, or SS06 Practice choice can resolve without a dead-end.
records.authority: Exact existing Script 01 and Script 02 content with binding v0.2 patches.
records.risk: Larger import surface; no additional content invention.

records.decision: Separated Marker, portable Artifact, Toolkit review, and Practice selection into explicit context-safe handoffs.
records.reason: Randomized route review found that saving a phrase could open Toolkit editing, marker intent could be asked twice, and SS02 could enter Practice handlers without an active Practice.
records.authority: v0.2 route-coherence repair; prototype binding until incorporated into the next product-content decision record.
records.risk: Adds three short bridge nodes, but removes ambiguous and unresolvable transitions.

records.decision: Added semantic checks for Practice identity, context-safe completion, exclusive uncertainty choices, and noninteractive summary rows.
records.reason: The prior validator checked referential integrity but could pass semantically contradictory or context-dependent routes.
records.risk: Future content changes must preserve or intentionally revise these invariants.

records.decision: Made the S2 review distinguish worlds actually visited from worlds merely planned, and hid review answers for unvisited worlds.
records.reason: A second randomized route review found that ending after W1 could still produce a W3 continuity answer and wording that implied every planned world had been traversed.
records.authority: v0.3 route-coherence repair; prototype binding until incorporated into the next product-content decision record.
records.risk: The runtime must track the visited-world set explicitly.

records.decision: Gated Toolkit scope and inventory controls by active trigger, starter, target, and change kind; clarified the Artifact return-pointer label.
records.reason: A manual route could offer 'Only this trigger' without a trigger, or offer 'Save to inventory only' for a removal or sequencing change.
records.authority: v0.3 route-coherence repair; prototype binding until incorporated into the next product-content decision record.
records.risk: The renderer must evaluate explicit display and route conditions before showing a control.

records.decision: Replaced a no-op 'Reword it' return with an explicit run-only user-rewording handler and required recovery entry to retain its origin node.
records.reason: The second route audit showed that the prior control returned to identical wording and could loop while implying that rewording had occurred.
records.authority: v0.3 route-coherence repair; prototype binding until incorporated into the next product-content decision record.
records.risk: User-authored wording must remain volatile unless separately saved and must never be interpreted as diagnostic data.
